title: AF anticoagulation flips with severe renal failure
task: As of the decision date, decide whether a DOAC is appropriate for non-valvular atrial fibrillation requiring anticoagulation, excluding severe renal failure with creatinine clearance below 15 mL/min.

record.text: Persistent non-valvular atrial fibrillation with CHA2DS2-VASc score 5. No mechanical valve or moderate mitral stenosis.
Creatinine clearance 42 mL/min. Renal function permits labeled DOAC use.
Persistent non-valvular atrial fibrillation with CHA2DS2-VASc score 5. No mechanical valve or moderate mitral stenosis.
Creatinine clearance 12 mL/min, below 15 mL/min, severe renal failure and DOAC contraindication.

clinical_rationale: The controlled causal change is renal function crossing a severe renal contraindication threshold for DOAC therapy.
